interval: pointwise percentile 95%; descriptive, no equivalence margin or success gate
arc_gsm_subject_unit: paired official test item within task/filter; no pooling of benchmarks or GSM filters
mmlu_overall_unit: paired subject cluster; resample 57 subjects with replacement, aggregate correct counts divided by item counts in sampled subjects
wikitext_unit: paired document; resample 62 documents, sum loglikelihood and original-word/UTF8-byte denominators before exponentiation
metric_direction: candidate W4 minus BF16 for accuracy and NLL; all-answer disagreement distinct from correctness flips
choice_diagnostics: softmax of full-continuation choice loglikelihoods; not next-token full-vocabulary probabilities
full_vocabulary_KL: NOT_RUN; serving API and official harness do not retain complete vocabulary vectors
failures: retain every failed attempt; incomplete task/model pairs are unavailable, not silently intersected
